title: Motion Sciences anti-gravity effort debunked

tellings.quote: Yeah, in 2010 Dr. Puthoff and Dr. Green were part of the science advisory board for an effort called Motion Sciences

plain: In 2010, an effort called Motion Sciences tried to build anti-gravity technology in a hangar at Provo Airport in Utah, and in the end it was shown not to work. The current owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, tells Michels he saw this himself. He says two scientists, Hal Puthoff and Kit Green, "were part of the science advisory board," and he also brings up a man named Joe Firmage in connection with the project.
